numinance.kinds.v1.CanaryStage.jsonschem.description: CanaryStage is one step of a canary rollout.

name.description: name is required: a lower-case token (letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter), unique in the plan.

weight.description: weight is required: the share of production traffic, in percent, the new revision takes during the stage, 1 to 100.

numinance.kinds.v1.CanaryStage.jsonschem.title: Canary Stage

numinance.kinds.v1.RolloutPlan.jsonschem.description:
RolloutPlan is the staged rollout of a released change: it is verified in the staging environment, then it takes
 rising shares of production traffic, each observed for the window. The deployment targets (the cdprovider and the
 observability provider) come from the AdapterSelector binding, never from this message.

production.description: production is required: the customer-named production environment, different from staging.

stages.description: stages is required: 1 to 8 canary stages in order, with unique names and strictly rising weights that end at 100.

staging.description: staging is required: the customer-named staging environment (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, 1 to 63 bytes).

window.description: window is required: how long the staging deployment and each stage are observed; at least 1 minute, at most 24 hours.

numinance.kinds.v1.RolloutPlan.jsonschem.title: Rollout Plan
